notes.title: UPDATE #4 && 50% OFF
notes.content:
Zombie Desperation 1.2.0 is now online!

Hello Everyone!

This new version has a couple new things like....a new pickup, the "ElectroVest". It shocks the enemies that attack you, enabling you to last a couple more hits. Will keep your guts inside a little longer....

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/9e46f1f95c62f8a47ab33afe09bb22571e9260ed.gif

It is available since the first area, grab it! 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/773988dfee92a24ca2aba71e44330fc793f35da5.jpg

Several VFX have been updated as you can see in the following gifs
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/a389fde330d6fc20e8cb6ba46d588b3c9922aef1.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/7f5be6391fc07d08595b6b758e6be278e20c6d47.gif

And last, but no less important, we have created a section in the main menu where you can change your crosshair. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/c74186c05d20a7d9f58efe3d409bf0a9d905088d.jpg

And as always, thank you for playing our games!

notes.title: SUMMER SALE 50% OFF! & UPDATE #3
notes.content:
Hello Everyone

We've added light effects to the explosive weapons and flamethrower. This originally was part of a larger update in development....but! we wanted to say Happy Summer Sale! and we didn't want to do it empty handed. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/e26dbde69214cf5306ae0ca78685202de030f26d.gif

We hope you are able to buy games to your heart content. 

Thanks!

PD. The intel files bug should have been fixed too. Please post in the bugs thread if the issues are still there.

notes.title: UPDATE #2 - Zombie Desperation is 40% off! Over 100,000 zombies killed!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/49b2094c7bd90ad20c15435d323368d6c87d11e5.jpg

Zombie Desperation v1.1.38 is now online

Bug fixes and Improvements

Collectibles. There are now hidden "flash drives" in every map. Shoot a  certain area for the pickups to pop in. They will unlock files with data from the now deceased people of the game world, read them altogether to flesh out the story of the game, similar to the leftover notes in survival games. 
New Achievements. Two new achievements have been added. Unlock them by collecting the flash drives.
Archives Menu. Read the info contained in the flash drives.
Currently there are only 8 files, but there will be more in the future.
PlayerStats. Players will now be able to check out detailed data about their performance, such as kills with every weapon. Useful to keep track of the achievement counters and to see other interesting stuff.
Small Bug Fixes.
Balancing Changes


Incoming New Stuff/Fixes

New Items. Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
New types of crosshairs
Textures Fix. Several linux players have reported black textures in the deepest layer of the background graphics.


Words from the devs
Although small, we hope you enjoyed the game. By playing, you are contributing to make the world a safest place....once there is a zombie apocalypse... look forward to the next updates.

Join our  Steam Group and like our  Facebook page, there will be several giveaways early next month! We have recently started to promote both sites, so there is barely anyone, cough cough free keys almost warranted. Also check out our latest game  Visceral Cubes if you have the chance.

And as always, thank you for your support!

notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/ec2718b839933e5ec5f569a8c644d152190bdd4d.gif

Zombie Desperation v1.0.28 is now online

Bug fixes and Improvements

Flamethrower. This new weapon will be available on every level. The flames will stay in the map for a few seconds, continuously killing the zombies in that spot. Smartly used to block spawns for a little while.
Armored Zombie Headshot. You can no longer headshot armored zombies.
Gutshot. You can no longer headshot bleeders(the monster in the gif), instead you need to shoot it in the gut for a "gutshot".
Stacking Ammo. Picking two weapons of the same type will now stack the ammo.
New spawn. A new zombie spawn has been added to the lobby level. Only 3 were working. Because of this, the difficult in that level will be increased.
AdrenalineFix. Fixed a bug related to the adrenaline where the zombies were "teleporting".
IceGrenadeFix. Fixed a bug where the frozen zombies appeared somewhere else after being frozen.
Several other minor bug fixes and gameplay balancing changes.


Incoming New Stuff/Fixes

New Items. Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
Collectibles. Find collectibles to unlock documents with info about the game background story.
PlayerStats. Players will be able to see some gameplay info such as the kills they have done with every weapon.
New achievements
New types of crosshairs
Textures Fix. Several linux players have reported black textures in the deepest layer of the background graphics.


Words from the devs
The flamethrower weapon was intended for a later update but we added it on this one as it was impeding the players to get all the achievements. Sorry for the trouble. Players asked, players served.

And as always, thanks for your support!

notes.title: Zombie Desperation is now available... 40% off!
notes.content:
Another small horror experience has been unleashed, we hope you enjoy Zombie Desperation! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32262387/4f469a1c2ea5e7efd2425a0f0ef4ce360a75946e.gif

ZD is a port from a mobile game originally released in 2011. It was a good hit back these days, however we had to take it down as there was no one to support it back then. 

Now, like a zombie (ironically) it comes back with some of the features that the platform has to offer, such as leaderboards and achievements. Some of the graphics have been improved to stand up to the challenge of time and now with better performance, more fluid action will take place.

We hope you'll be able to get enough fun out of the 1 USD you will spend for the game, and if you don't, there will be free content in the future. Oh yeah there is a launch discount, grab the game while its hot.

Don't hesitate to post about any bug or issue you find on the bugs thread.

Incoming New Stuff

New Items. Weapons and new defensive gadgets.
Balancing. Some weapons and enemies will be revisited to make the game more enjoyable.


And as always, thanks for your support!
